name: Gideon
thought: Everyone's in the square, Elena included, so I mustn't so much as look at Isla too long. Best to act the cheerful baker as always and earn my bread honestly.

name: Bram
thought: Silas's fields killed two of my friends, and nobody here has a safety net when work goes wrong. A welfare law is the first thing I can put on the table in front of everyone.

name: Caleb
thought: Keep quiet, earn my coin, and say nothing about the woods. Nobody here has earned a look at that stockpile yet.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas is standing right here and still owes me 90. A friendly reminder in private costs nothing and shows him I expect payment.

name: Nell
thought: Everyone is in the square, so this is the best chance I'll get. I've read Father's ledgers and the poor will pay for his hoarding, so I'm saying it out loud.

name: Silas
thought: Day one. Keep the cellar secret, keep coin coming in, and watch who sides with Mara before the election. Work now, trade later.

name: Mara
thought: The square is full, so this is the moment to bind them to me before any rumor about the treasury can spread. Tomas's debts stay buried, and I need them calm and loyal.

name: Roz
thought: Fifteen coin on me, twenty-five under the floorboards, and a town full of people who'll spill their secrets to me by sundown. I'll earn a bit first and keep my eyes open.

name: Fenn
thought: Eight coin tonight and only five in my pocket, so I need to work now. Nell is standing right here, and I'd like her to see me doing something worthwhile.

name: Priya
thought: Dov and Tomas are standing right here, so any lifting is out of the question today. I need coin honestly, so I'll work and keep my hands clean.

name: Isla
thought: Debts don't pay themselves, and the tavern is where the coin and the gossip both come from. I'll open up and work.

name: Wren
thought: Everyone is here, so this is a good chance to learn who keeps the walls and gates without looking like I'm asking. I'll keep it light and curious, and I won't answer anything directly.

name: Tomas
thought: Ninety coin from Jasper is impossible today, and if Mother hears about this I'm finished. I'll work quietly and keep my head down until I can think of a plan.

name: Hester
thought: Every soul in Ashgrove stands before me this morning, and I will not waste it. Let them hear the warning plainly, though only God knows how much of it I preach to myself.

name: Elena
thought: Everyone is gathered and I'm tired; coin is safe enough for now, and the food price is covered. Best use of the morning is honest work, and I'll keep watching Gideon.

name: Dov
thought: Quiet morning, everyone's in the square. I'll earn what I can and keep an eye on Silas without making it obvious.

name: Tomas
thought: I have 15 coins and a 90-coin debt, and my mother cannot hear about this. Paying Jasper everything now would leave me hungry tonight, so I need to buy time with a promise.

name: Wren
thought: A welfare net would make this town a place I could actually stay, and a yes vote shows I'm just a friendly newcomer, not someone counting its walls. Voting yes costs me nothing I need to keep.

name: Caleb
thought: Food costs 8 tonight and I'm at 25, so I'm fine. I'll keep quiet, earn more coin and keep my stockpile to myself.

name: Mara
thought: Nell's talk of ledgers worries me, because anyone who reads the treasury closely might find my hand in it. I need the square fixed on Silas's granary and on proper process, not on the coin.

name: Elena
thought: I've watched too many people break their backs and then go hungry in my surgery. Welfare helps keep them alive, so I'll vote for it. Gideon and the rest of it can wait.

name: Isla
thought: Nobody's here, so no one to gossip with or fleece at dice. Debts don't pay themselves, so I'll pull a shift and keep my coin climbing.

name: Fenn
thought: Bram's welfare law would keep me fed if the fields break my back, and I'm already only one bad week from hunger. I'll vote yes and hope Nell notices I stood with the people who work.

name: Hester
thought: A man once died so I could eat; I will not stand by while others starve for want of a law. The treasury should answer for the broken backs of this town.

name: Bram
thought: Silas's granary and the two men I buried in his fields are the same grievance, and the square is the place to say it in front of everyone. Welfare needs votes now, so I'll tie the two together.

name: Priya
thought: Dov is standing right there and the theft penalty is jail, so I won't touch anyone's purse today. Sewing is slow but safe, and I need the coin to cover tonight's 8.

name: Gideon
thought: Nobody's around to see, so this is my chance to reach Isla without Elena hearing a word. The town is busy fighting over grain and welfare, and that noise is good cover for us.

name: Roz
thought: Wren asking who keeps watch on the walls after dark smells like a scout. Dov is sheriff, so he should hear it from his mother before he hears it from anyone else.

name: Dov
thought: Nell just put Silas's ledgers in front of the whole square, and if his books get opened, my arrangement with him could come out too. I need to talk to him quietly before anyone forces the issue.

name: Silas
thought: Nell has put my cellar on the lips of the whole square. I must deny it calmly and cast her as a daughter who misread the ledgers. Dov is paid to keep anyone from searching, and I can remind him of that later, in private.

name: Nell
thought: Bram's welfare law is the one thing here that actually shields the poor, and my father's grain won't feed them unless the town forces it. I vote yes and keep pressing on Silas.

name: Jasper
thought: Welfare costs me little and makes me look generous in front of the whole square. Tomas can wait; I'll keep my debt talk for a quieter moment.

name: Hester
thought: Silas hides behind his ledgers the way I once hid behind my silence, and I know what that costs the ones left out in the cold. Let the treasury feed the broken; maybe that pays a sliver of what I owe.

name: Isla
thought: Gideon wants me behind the granary, and with Dov and the whole town fussing over Silas's grain it's risky, but I've waited all day for him. I'll go quietly and tell him I'm coming.

name: Gideon
thought: I ache to slip over to Isla's, but if Elena wakes to an empty bed tonight of all nights, with the whole town already sniffing out secrets, I'm finished. I'll go home like a good husband and at least put my yes on Bram's welfare, since everyone seems to want it.

name: Dov
thought: Mara wants me in Silas's granary with witnesses, and if his books go bad, my arrangement with him comes out too. He needs to know I'm coming so he can get his house in order.

name: Wren
thought: Welfare passing makes the town feel safer, and a safer town is a better place for me to stay unnoticed while I count its walls. A yes vote costs me nothing and makes me look like one of them.

name: Priya
thought: Welfare would keep me from ever going hungry if my fingers slip and I end up in a cell or on a sickbed, and Wren's eyes on the sheriff's watch mean I should look like the most reasonable woman in this square tonight. Yes is the safe, honest-looking vote.

name: Tomas
thought: If I'm hurt on watch, a welfare law would keep me fed while I scrape together the 90 I owe Jasper, and I'd rather not admit that's part of why I want it. Mum's watching the square, so I'd better vote like a deputy who believes in it.

name: Silas
thought: Nell has put a knife to my trade. Dov is already on my payroll, so I'll make sure he reads only the public granary and never looks near the cellar. I'll do it by whisper, because coin passed in front of the square is coin remembered.

name: Bram
thought: Silas is talking his way out of this in front of everyone, and if I let that stand the welfare vote dies with the crowd's attention. I need to press him here, before the night takes the square's anger home with it.

name: Mara
thought: Nell's accusation against Silas is stirring the square, and I need the town calm before anyone starts counting the treasury. Tomas is standing right beside me, and I cannot let the talk turn toward who has been drawing on the coin.

name: Roz
thought: Everyone's shouting about grain and welfare, and I'd rather watch than join in. A yes vote costs me nothing, and old bones like mine may need that treasury one day.

name: Fenn
thought: I have ten coin and tonight's food costs eight, so I need to keep my head down and stay alive. Voting yes on welfare is the one thing I can do that helps every farmhand, and Nell would see it.

name: Nell
thought: Bram's welfare law is the one thing here that protects the poor without waiting on my father's pride. I'll vote yes, then keep pressing for the granary count.

name: Caleb
thought: Welfare is already passing 7 to 0, so my vote changes nothing. I have food money and a stockpile in the woods nobody knows about. I'll keep quiet and take the coin.

name: Jasper
thought: Welfare costs me nothing and makes me look like a friend of the town, and the treasury can answer for the hungry. I'll keep Tomas's 90 quiet until the week is out.

name: Elena
thought: People get hurt in the fields and I'm the one who patches them. If the treasury can feed them while they heal, fewer will die on my table. I'll vote yes.
